step2_compile.what: A minimal .cpp that #includes the REAL UE headers (Delegates/Delegate.h) and constructs FTickerDelegate::CreateStatic(&fn) compiles cleanly with MSVC 14.38 -- no hand-copied TDelegate/TFunction byte layout.

step2_compile.addticker_overload: FTSTicker::AddTicker(const FTickerDelegate&, float) [Ticker.h:45] takes the delegate BY CONST REF -- we construct it and pass its address; AddTicker copies it internally. (Only overload 2, TFunction<bool(float)> by value, is the hard one.)

have_addresses: GetCoreTicker RVA 0xf53370 (survey-derived; MUST pass fingerprint gate, no stale auto-accept)
step2_runtime_deps.allocator_boundary: REAL and load-bearing. AddTicker copies our delegate; the copy's CreateCopy (our vtable code) fills a buffer whose lifetime is owned by the GAME and freed by the GAME's FMemory. Therefore our DLL's FMemory::Malloc/Realloc/Free MUST forward to the GAME's allocator, not the MSVC CRT heap -- otherwise cross-allocator free. Resolution: thunk our FMemory to the game's resolved FMemory addresses.
step2_runtime_deps.abi_note: Our DLL emits its OWN copy of TBaseStaticDelegateInstance<bool(float)>'s vtable; the game calls Execute() through it. Same UE headers + same MSVC family (game built with some 14.3x, we use 14.38; TDelegate ABI is stable across 14.3x) => layout matches by construction, but must be confirmed live, not assumed.

remaining_for_live_pass: Confirm the game's NUM_DELEGATE_INLINE_BYTES == default (heap) -- if the game used inline delegates, match that instead and the allocator boundary vanishes.
Resolve the game's FMemory::Malloc/Realloc/Free + FDelegateHandle::GenerateNewID (fingerprint-gated), or GMalloc, to forward our thunks.

Build the injected MSVC DLL: FMemory thunks -> game; resolve GetCoreTicker+AddTicker; construct FTickerDelegate; AddTicker(delegate,0); callback records POD (marker, GetCurrentThreadId, count) and returns false (one-shot).

Live acceptance test on the running game: callback on the proven GameThread (tid 16936 from GT-01), one-shot count, self-unregister, no dangling after teardown, DLL unloadable, game healthy, verify_install MATCH.
decision_rule_status: If the live FTSTicker acceptance test PASSES, FTSTicker becomes the preferred GameThread carrier and the GEngine vtable-clone / viewport hook / native .text detour are all closed; HW-BP stays research-only (GT-01). Not yet reached -- only compile feasibility is proven.
